content: {"summary":"Customers frequently report delivery delays and mis‑shipping, citing that items arrive late or in wrong order, especially for Prime members expecting same‑day service. Several complaints highlight damaged packaging, with broken seals and scratched discs, raising concerns about handling quality. Users also express frustration over unresponsive customer support and lack of communication, noting missing notifications or failed delivery attempts. These issues suggest a need to improve logistics coordination, packaging standards, and proactive updates for Prime customers."}
